scope: Distinct non-RF MOS catalog models plus explicit public ESD PMOS and differently named public native ESD model. No RF, SRAM or SONOS inheritance.
closure_candidate: Authenticate and enforce documented signed three-axis model voltage constraints, including conditional 16 V drain allowance, with explicit unknown temperature/rating/SOA results.
coordinate_definition: vds=V(d)-V(s), vgs=V(g)-V(s), vbs=V(b)-V(s); signed volts, inclusive bounds, no source/drain interchange.

anchors.text: a. Any HV NMOS device: 7.3 V @ 25C.
b. Any HV PMOS device: 8.1 V @ 25C.
These voltages are not operating voltages, but points of failure.
a. Any HV NMOS device: 11.0 V @ 25C.
b. Any HV PMOS device: 11.0 V @ 25C.
These voltages are not operating voltages, but points of failure.
Very High Voltage is defined as a voltage outside the range of GND to High Voltage (11V). Very high voltage is 16V (12V nominal) Vcc.

generic_hv_failure_context.decision: HV 7.3/8.1 V gate and 11 V junction @25C are explicitly failure points, not operating ratings. VHV nominal 12 V/max16 V and 5.5 V criteria are class/context facts; do not map to a named modern model or derive SOA without explicit applicability.

temperature_decision: 0/27/85 C are selected integration points, not supported extrema. A model tnom example is a nominal reference parameter. No public MOS temperature range established in reviewed sources.

next_bounded_acceptance.accept_when: Obtain an unambiguous exact-model source definition before implementing limits; no core-model alias inheritance.
